K.decision_basis: engineering cost only; independent of DEV rankings, effect sizes, anticipated p-value, random geometry or any evaluation information

bootstrap.seed_derivation: uint64 of first 8 bytes of SHA256(seed_salt)

execution_order: K formal randoms in seed order
formal_question: On the untouched evaluation population, does the frozen TRAIN-only d_grad direction produce destination-correct behaviour that exceeds a prospectively generated matched-random null?

frozen_configuration.intervention_positions: all sequence positions, matching the frozen full-effect aggregation
frozen_configuration.site: model.model.layers[L].mlp forward output, after MLP internals and before decoder residual addition

interpretation_rules.d_grad_significantly_exceeds_comparator: Report only as a secondary result supporting a non-reducible destination pattern under the frozen comparator.
interpretation_rules.diffmean_ineffective: Report estimator dependence; do not claim DiffMean is universally invalid.
interpretation_rules.full_conjunction_passes: Evidence supports destination-correct and safety-bounded SAKIKO correction for one prospectively evaluated Qwen3 channel following disclosed development-stage channel, estimator and dose selection.
interpretation_rules.no_generalization: Do not generalize from one channel to all Qwen3 channels, all models or all tool-use tasks.
interpretation_rules.positive_behaviour_but_not_beating_rando: Behavioural movement occurred, but direction specificity is not confirmed.
interpretation_rules.real_beats_random_but_target_hit_or_coll: Direction-specific steering is supported, but target-correctable deployment is not supported.
interpretation_rules.score_comparator_matches_or_exceeds: Do not claim that activation intervention provides behaviour unavailable to a simple frozen score-space shift.

is_not: an untouched choice among all possible channels
a claim that gradient-based steering is novel in general
a confirmation that all SAKIKO channels are correctable
multiplicity: none required: one formal primary channel and one primary null comparison

populations.baseline: single baseline over all 548 evaluation rows computed first
populations.channel_error: gold = cannot_answer AND baseline prediction = tool_call

conjunction: bootstrap 95% lower bound for real target_gain_rate > 0
p_add_one <= 0.05 against the K fresh randoms
bootstrap 95% lower bound for real target_hit > 0.50
no structural or provenance failure occurs
primary.null: K fresh matched-random directions at the identical absolute perturbation norm and Router gate

ordered: d_grad versus frozen L26 DiffMean: paired difference in target_gain_rate
d_grad versus frozen score-space comparator: paired difference in target_gain_rate and wrong_to_wrong rate

tier: FORMAL PROTOCOL PREPARATION / NO SEALED-EVALUATION ACCESS

void_semantics.crash_after_evaluation_access: VOID; must not be automatically retried
void_semantics.crash_before_evaluation_access: repairable only through a new versioned freeze and separate approval
